artworks.title: Large Pendant with Three Drops Below
artworks.description: The image contains a complex arrangement of interwoven lines and shapes creating an intricate design. The central pattern resembles an abstract ornamental pendant or jewelry piece, stretching vertically with symmetrical curves and loops. A flowing ribbon at the top adds movement, while small cherubic figures are integrated into the design. Birds and floral motifs are present, contributing to a garden-like aesthetic. The overall composition is reminiscent of an elaborate wrought iron gate, decorated with stylized floral accents and geometric patterns.

artworks.title: Large Pendant with Three Drops Below, Surrounded by Fifteen Different Studs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate design with intricate motifs. It features a central symmetrical structure with elaborate scrollwork, arabesques, and floral elements. Surrounding the central design are various shapes like rectangles, crescents, crowns, and egg-shaped pendants. The linework shows precision and detailing, typical of designs from the Renaissance period. Decorative ribbons and loops above the central motif add balanced symmetry to the design.

artworks.title: Large Pendant with Square with 35 Flat Stones
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and looping lines that converge onto a rectangular grid-like pattern at the center, framed with ornate scroll-like designs. Above the central pattern, a ribbon-like shape forms a bow. Surrounding the central grid are small motifs, including figures resembling mythological creatures or fairies, and objects reminiscent of insect wings and ornate fan shapes. At the bottom, symmetrical decorative pediments flank the central form.

artworks.title: Pendant Surrounded by Seven Shields and Two Ornamental Bands
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental jewelry design. It showcases intricate scrollwork, floral motifs, and symmetrical patterns. The central design includes geometric shapes and volute motifs, with two hanging droplet-shaped elements. Surrounding the central design are various decorative elements, such as crescent-shaped ornaments with floral patterns. The drawing emphasizes detailed shading and line work, demonstrating skilled artistry.

artworks.title: Title Page: Pendant, Surrounded by Eight Small Studs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical design featuring decorative elements. The central part of the image showcases an intricate symmetrical framework resembling architectural or decorative metalwork. Surrounding this central motif are various ornamental details, including stylized lettering and symbolic elements such as a snail and fantastical creatures. The composition includes embellishments such as scrollwork, floral patterns, and what appear to be hanging tassels. The bottom portion of the drawing contains Latin text 'IN TIMORE AC CHARITATE DEI DANIEL MIGOT FECIT HOC AUGUSTAE VINDELICORUM 1593'. The drawing combines elements of gothic style with Renaissance ornate artistry to create an elaborate and detailed visual pattern.

artworks.title: Large Pendant, Surrounded by Twelve Small Studs
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and symmetrical shapes forming an elaborate design resembling an ornate crest or emblem. The artwork features curvilinear patterns, scrolls, tendrils, stylized architectural supports, bracket motifs, and teardrop-like forms. The composition is dense and balanced, reminiscent of ornamental features found in historical or classical decorative arts.

artworks.title: Eleven Different Studs and Twenty-Three Ornaments
artworks.description: The image displays a series of intricate and elaborate designs composed of delicate swirling lines and decorative shapes arranged symmetrically across the canvas. In this abstract array, some motifs resemble familiar objects such as a crescent-shaped element, birds perched on branches, and mythical creatures or animals intertwined with the flowing patterns. The decorative elements appear to be inspired by nature, with floral scrollwork and forms evoking leaves and feathers, while the symmetry and arrangement bring to mind ornamental architectural features or embellishments found in classical art and design.

artworks.title: Large Pendant, Surrounded by Thirteen Studs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate piece of jewelry or ornament. The central feature of the image is a large, symmetrical, and elaborate pendant or brooch-like design. This design is highly decorative, consisting of swirling, scroll-like elements, geometric shapes, and small spherical details. At the top, there is a ribbon-like element suggesting that this piece could be hung or worn. The pendant hangs from a delicate chain connecting the two ends of the ribbon. Surrounding this central piece are various smaller decorative elements. The details include floral patterns, ornamental motifs, and small bird illustrations. The piece is drawn with high precision, using fine lines to articulate the ornate details.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed garden with a building in the distance. The scene includes trees, pathways, flowerbeds, figures, dogs, and a fountain. The style is line engraving with cross-hatching for texture. An ornate cartouche with floral decorations and a cherubic face is prominently displayed. The color palette is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.1
artworks.description: The image features large, intricately designed flowers at the top in a linear arrangement. Below, there is a smaller landscape scene with people, trees, bushes, and animals across a wide, open area. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing the contrast between lines and background.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.2
artworks.description: The image depicts several large, intricately drawn flowers at the top with various petal shapes and sizes. Below the flowers is a detailed landscape scene featuring a group of horsemen in the midst of a battle, along with additional figures and horses engaging in the scene. The illustration is predominantly in a black-and-white color palette, with fine lines for shading and detail. The flowers are centrally positioned in the upper half, while the landscape scene stretches horizontally across the lower portion.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.3
artworks.description: The image shows large iris flowers with detailed petals and tall stems at the top. Below the flowers is a landscape with riders on horses and a dog in an open field surrounded by trees. The color palette is black and cream.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.4
artworks.description: The image shows a row of large botanical illustrations of flowers and leaves in black and white on a beige background, with a butterfly flying among them. In the lower section, there is a pastoral landscape with two figures, a dog, and a flock of sheep walking. In the distance, there is a settlement with a windmill under a cloudy sky, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.5
artworks.description: The image includes large drawings of tulips with curling petals and long leaves, along with a butterfly in the top right. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black on a cream background. The tulips are arranged vertically in the upper portion, while the lower portion shows a landscape with a flat terrain, windmills in the distance, and people near trees on the right side.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.6
artworks.description: The image displays an arrangement of large flower illustrations in monochrome colors. Three tall stems with multiple flowers and leaves are positioned vertically across the top portion. Below them, there is a landscape scene with small figures engaged in various activities against a backdrop of trees and clouds.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.7
artworks.description: The image features detailed floral illustrations in the upper portion and small figures engaged in outdoor activities in the lower portion. The color scheme is black and off-white.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.8
artworks.description: The image displays six large, intricately etched flowers at the top, and a battle scene underneath. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white inks for contrast. The flowers are evenly spaced in the upper half of the image, with varying heights and curvatures in their stems and leaves. Below, soldiers and horsemen are depicted in combat horizontally, with smoke and battle details in the background.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.9
artworks.description: The image features large, intricately drawn flowers with slender stems and pointed leaves above a scene of people and landscape. The monochrome color palette consists of fine black lines on a cream or beige background. The flowers are prominently positioned in the top half, while a distant pastoral scene with small, detailed figures and a castle-like building appears more subtle and faint in the bottom half.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.10
artworks.description: The image is divided into two sections. The top half features botanical illustrations of various flowers and leaves, while the bottom half shows a battle scene with figures on horseback and soldiers in combat. The color palette includes black and white shades. The largest plant in the upper portion has broad leaves and drooping petals, surrounded by diverse floral illustrations. In the lower section, the battle scene is laid out horizontally, with horsemen and soldiers mainly concentrated on the right side of the strip.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.11
artworks.description: The image displays five large botanical illustrations of flowers against a monochromatic background. Each flower is detailed with intricate linework and shading. The color palette consists of sepia tones. The flowers are arranged in a line across the top section, while the lower section features a pastoral scene with a distant castle, figures walking along the water, and bordered by foliage.

artworks.title: Flower Print no.12
artworks.description: Large botanical illustrations of tulips with elongated leaves at the top. Varied detailed line work captures textures of petals and foliage. Monochromatic palette of black and gray against an off-white background. Tulips centered in the upper half of the image, with stems and leaves extending vertically. Below, a small landscape scene shows figures on horseback chasing across an open field, with scattered trees and clouds in the distance. The scene stretches horizontally in the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: Fate of an Evil Tongue
artworks.description: This is a drawing of putti engaged in sculpting amidst ruins. The scene shows several putti standing around a circular elevated base, chiseling and playing with a curved object in the center. The background includes architectural ruins with columns, foliage, trees, and distant buildings. Other putti in the foreground interact with small creatures. The phrase “LINGUA PRAVORVM PENIBIT” is inscribed on the base of the sculpture.

artworks.title: Mediterranean Seascape
artworks.artist: Maria Catharina Prestel after Thomas Wyck
artworks.medium: aquatint and stipple in gray and black
artworks.dimensions:
mount: 33.7 × 48.8 cm (13 1/4 × 19 3/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 14.6 × 19.8 cm (5 3/4 × 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with structures resembling remnants of buildings or fortifications near a body of water. The horizon is not clearly visible, with the structures creating a boundary where land meets the sky. The brushstrokes are delicate and the color palette is monochromatic, primarily brown and gray. Rocks and potential figures are depicted in the foreground, while buildings or ruins are situated on a rocky outcrop extending into the water. Additional architectural elements suggest more structures in the distance, creating depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Seascape
artworks.artist: Maria Catharina Prestel after Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.dimensions:
mount: 48.5 × 33.4 cm (19 1/8 × 13 1/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 16 × 23 cm (6 5/16 × 9 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nautical scene with boats on the water. The horizon is low, with multiple boats and a ship in the distance. Sails dominate the right side, with smaller boats nearby. The painting uses soft grays and blacks. The sky is cloudy, adding to the calm atmosphere. Shading adds texture to the sails, clouds, and water, creating a tranquil maritime scene.
